newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilts eye 113-24 support short term.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilts eye 113-24 support short term.

text.p: September gilt futures traded on LIFFE will come under short term pressure on Wednesday towards support at 113-24, after trading an outside down day in the previous session, technical analysts said.
However, the overall uptrend remains intact, and the trendline is unlikely to break, they said. The 113-24 level is trendline support drawn from the May 28 low of 112-05.
"I'm optimistic 113-24 will hold although it will tested," said Andy Cossor, fixed income analyst at Technical Data in London.
September gilts were down 1/32 at 114-01 by 0712 GMT.
On Tuesday, gilts traded in a range of 114-18 to 113-28, closing at 114-02.
A break of the trendline support will target the 113 and a half area of lows seen last week, analysts said.
Richard Adcock, manager of technical research at HSBC said in a note further downside would develop to test and break the uptrend line, which would confirm the chances of an extended move to 113-04.
"We use short term strength as a selling opportunity, placing stops over 114-16," he said.
Cossor said his initial upside resistance was 114-08.
The 114-08 level was the high on June 6 and 12.
Above there, the recent highs of 114-18 and 114-16 will cap any further gains. Longer term, the contract high set on May 9 at 114-31, is the market's goal.
At the short end, September short sterling was unchanged at 93.16 .
